law_refs.quote: on or after the 9th day of June, 1952

tests.objects: Respondent tenant; alleged disposition of the shop to son Arun Sood; tenancy governed by a rent agreement dated 18 July 1988.
tests.opposition: The respondent expressly denies subletting or parting with possession. The precise date of the alleged arrangement with Arun Sood is not supplied, but any disposition by the respondent under the identified tenancy would postdate the statutory cutoff.

opposition_refs.quote: It is wrong and is denied that the respondent has Sub- letted, assigned or otherwise parted with the tenancy premises

tests.rationale: The identified tenancy agreement dates from 1988, and the allegation concerns a disposition by that tenant during the tenancy. The temporal threshold is supported for the alleged arrangement without accepting that a qualifying disposition occurred.

source_refs.quote: the respondent had sub- let the shop to his son Arun Sood
it also being not disputed that the son was engaged in the business of Sood Store which was run simultaneously from the premises
Arun Sood, the son of the respondent had opened a bank account in the name of Sood Stores.

law_refs.quote: the transfer of an interest in the estate payment of rent, and the right to possession as against the tenant in respect of the Premises sublet.

tests.objects: Respondent tenant as alleged sublandlord; Arun Sood as purported subtenant; Sood Store or Sood Stores as business identifiers; the tenanted shop.
tests.opposition: The respondent admits his son's presence and separate business activities but asserts that he continues conducting business and retains possession and control. A business sign, telephone connection, and bank account corroborate Arun Sood's business presence, not necessarily a tenancy relationship with the respondent.

opposition_refs.quote: The respondent himself is in use, occupation and possession of the tenanted shop
he continues to be in possession and control of the tenanted shop.
The photographs depict display of the sign board of Sood Stores across the subject premises.

tests.gap_reason: The record does not establish rent paid by Arun Sood to the respondent, transfer of an estate interest, or a right of possession against the tenant. Whether the son's business constitutes a separate subtenancy rather than concurrent family business activity remains unresolved.
tests.rationale: Multiple records support the son's presence and business operation, including official telephone and banking evidence. None independently establishes the complete incidents of subletting required by the supplied legal test.

the respondent has already sub-letted, assigned and otherwise parted with the tenancy premises

law_refs.quote: In assignment the tenant has to divest himself of all the rights that he has as a tenant.

tests.objects: Alleged assignment by the respondent tenant to an unidentified assignee, potentially but not conclusively identified with Arun Sood.
tests.opposition: The respondent denies assignment and asserts continued possession. The more specific evidence concerns Arun Sood's business and presence, which cannot by itself establish an assignment of all tenancy rights or identify him conclusively as the alleged assignee.

opposition_refs.quote: It is wrong and is denied that the respondent has Sub- letted, assigned or otherwise parted with the tenancy premises
he continues to be in possession and control of the tenanted shop.

tests.gap_reason: The alleged assignee is not independently identified, and no instrument, admission, or sufficiently specific evidence establishes divestiture of all of the respondent's tenancy rights.
tests.rationale: The pleading asserts assignment, but the supplied evidence does not distinguish an assignment of tenancy rights from the son's business activities or demonstrate complete divestiture.

source_refs.quote: the respondent tenant is not at all in possession thereof and sub tenant is in exclusive possession of tenancy shop.
he was in exclusive use of the premises, running his business in the name and style of M/s Sood Store.
a telephone connection in the name of Arun Sood, son of the respondent was installed in the premises.

law_refs.quote: there must be vesting of possession by the tenant in another person by divesting himself not only of physical possession but also of the right to possession

tests.objects: Alleged transfer of physical and legal possession of the tenanted shop from the respondent to Arun Sood.
tests.opposition: The respondent claims to operate his own business alongside his son's and retain control of the shop. The admitted presence of Arun Sood and the existence of business-related records do not directly resolve whether the tenant relinquished his legal right to possess.

opposition_refs.quote: wherein he in the company of his son, has been running
his argument being that he is assisted in the business run from the premises by his said son
he continues to be in possession and control of the tenanted shop.

tests.gap_reason: The decisive unresolved issue is whether Arun Sood's use wholly ousted the respondent from physical and legal possession, or whether the respondent retained possession and control while permitting simultaneous business activity.
tests.rationale: Exclusive possession is directly alleged, and Arun Sood's business activity is supported by documentary and official-witness evidence. However, the respondent's specific account of retained possession remains opposed rather than conclusively disproved.

source_refs.quote: As per terms and conditions of the rent agreement the respondent has no right to sub-let, assign or otherwise part with the possession of the tenancy premises

law_refs.quote: without obtaining the consent in writing of the landlord;

tests.objects: Written landlord consent for an alleged subletting, assignment, or parting with possession of the shop to Arun Sood or another alleged recipient.
tests.opposition: The respondent states that he did not violate the rent agreement and denies any relevant disposition. Neither the alleged contractual restriction nor the denial directly determines whether written landlord consent was obtained for the arrangement alleged.

opposition_refs.quote: the respondent has not violated any of the terms of said agreement date 18.7.88 of rent.

tests.gap_reason: The rent agreement's prohibition is described, but no direct evidence or finding establishes the absence of a separate written landlord consent to the particular alleged disposition.
tests.rationale: A contractual restriction against subletting is relevant background but does not conclusively establish the statutory proposition that written consent was not obtained.

law_refs.quote: If there is anything in the nature of a right to concurrent user there is no parting with possession
The mere user by other persons is no parting with Possession so long as the tenant retains the legal possession himself

tests.objects: Respondent tenant's claimed continuing legal possession and concurrent business use with son Arun Sood in the tenanted shop.
tests.opposition: The petitioners allege that the respondent is entirely out of possession and that the alleged subtenant exclusively controls the shop. The respondent's retained-control claim is supported by his account of participating in the business, but the supplied passages do not establish an unopposed legal-possession finding.

opposition_refs.quote: the respondent tenant is not at all in possession thereof and sub tenant is in exclusive possession of tenancy shop.
he was in exclusive use of the premises

tests.gap_reason: The respondent's continuing legal right to possession, as distinguished from participation in business and physical presence, is disputed. The supplied record does not conclusively establish whether the alleged arrangement excluded the respondent from legal possession.
tests.rationale: The respondent gives a specific account of retained occupation and simultaneous business activity, directly engaging the concurrent-use qualification. The opposing allegation of exclusive possession prevents an unqualified finding on the literal retained-legal-possession proposition.

tests.objects: The tenanted shop allegedly occupied exclusively by Arun Sood.

opposition_refs.quote: The respondent himself is in use, occupation and possession of the tenanted shop
